about: Marula surface pack, wave 1. It holds three references: the Tickets list (the data-surface template), the shared kit (chrome, palette, chat, dock, assistant column, components, the AI ladder) and Dispatch (time grid, drag, double-booking, density, and the AI plan editor). Every other route in the brief derives from one of these plus the ticket workbench pack. Desktop themes drawn: neutral and dark. State numbering is identical across themes.

images.title: Dragging a ticket over a free slot
images.what_to_notice: #18441 (30 minutes) is being dragged over Riya N.'s lane. The lane is outlined in gold, the ghost is a dashed gold outline with a gold tint, and an ink chip above it reads 11:45 to 12:15 with the duration. The card in the queue has become a dashed placeholder.

images.what_to_notice: #18437 is dragged over Jordan T.'s off block from 14:00. The lane outline and the ghost are blush and hatched, and the chip reads Jordan T. is off until 18:00 with an alert icon. Someone who is off is always blocked, whatever the overlap policy. Nothing is red.

images.title: Drop rejected
images.what_to_notice: After releasing over Jordan T.'s off block, the lane is tinted blush, #18437 is still in the queue, and a toast reads Not placed. Jordan T. is off until 18:00.

images.title: Keyboard pick-up and move
images.what_to_notice: #18421 has been picked up with Enter: its original position is a dashed outline, the ghost sits in Naledi P.'s lane at 14:00 with a chip reading 14:00 to 14:45, and a one-cell cursor is outlined. A help chip at the bottom lists the arrows, plus and minus for length, Enter to drop and Esc to cancel.

images.title: Two collisions flagged, one can be kept
images.what_to_notice: A blush banner reads 2 collisions today and names both: Alex M.'s #18348 now runs into #18344, and Jordan T. is off from 12:00 while #18339 runs to 12:30. It offers Review first and Keep it (Keep it applies to the job-on-job collision only, never to someone who is off).
